Piotr Rutkowski | mgrtitle = Head coach | manager = [[Niels Frederiksen]] | league = [[Ekstraklasa]] | season = [[2025–26 Ekstraklasa|2025–26]] | position = Ekstraklasa, 1st of 18 (champions) |pattern_la1 = _lech2627h |pattern_b1 = _lech2627h |pattern_ra1 = _lech2627h |pattern_sh1 = _lech2627h |pattern_so1 = _lech2627hl |leftarm1 = 0000ff |body1 = 0000ff |rightarm1 = 0000ff |shorts1 = ffffff |socks1 = ffffff |pattern_la2 = _lech2627a |pattern_b2 = _lech2627a |pattern_ra2 = _lech2627a |pattern_sh2 = _lech2627a |pattern_so2 = _lech2627al |leftarm2 = ffffff |body2 = ffffff |rightarm2 = ffffff |shorts2 = 0000ff |socks2 = 0000ff |pattern_la3 = _lech2627t |pattern_b3 = _lech2627t |pattern_ra3 = _lech2627t |pattern_sh3 = _lech2627t |pattern_so3 = _blacktop |leftarm3 = afafaf |body3 = afafaf |rightarm3 = afafaf |shorts3 = 000000 |socks3 = afafaf | current = 2026–27 Lech Poznań season | website = {{official URL}} }} {{Lech Poznań sections}} '''Kolejowy Klub Sportowy Lech Poznań''' ({{Literal translation|Railway Sports Club Lech Poznań}}), commonly referred to as '''KKS Lech Poznań''' or simply '''Lech Poznań''' ({{IPA|pol|lɛx ˈpɔznaj̃}}), is a Polish professional [[association football|football]] club based in [[Poznań]] and currently competing in the [[Ekstraklasa]], the nation's highest division. The club was established on 19 March 1922 as ''KS Lutnia Dębiec'', later changing its name several times. Until 1994, the club was closely linked to [[Polish State Railways|Polish State Railways (PKP)]]. As a result, its popular nickname is '''''Kolejorz''''' {{IPA|pl|kɔˈlɛjɔʂ|}}, which means '''The Railwayman''' in local [[slang]]. The club's debut in the Polish top division took place in the year 1948. The brightest era of Lech was in the early 1980s and early 1990s when they won 5 Polish league titles, 3 Polish Cups and a Polish Super Cup. Lech has won the Polish league a total of ten times, most recently in 2026, and is the most popular football club in the [[Greater Poland]] region.{{cite web |url=https://www.lechpoznan.pl/1922-do-dzis,39.html |title=1922 do dziś |publisher=Lech Poznań |access-date=20 July 2020}}"}}
